INTERPRETING THE BALANCE SHEET:
- Assets = what the company owns (cash, receivables, equipment, etc.)
- Liabilities = what the company owes (payables, loans, credit cards, etc.)
- Equity = net worth (Assets - Liabilities)
- The accounting equation ALWAYS holds: Assets = Liabilities + Equity
